name: Roshan Singh H
title: Entry-Level Data Engineer | ETL & Snowflake Developer
summary: Entry-level Data Engineer with hands-on experience in SQL, Snowflake, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, and data migration. Experienced with SQL Server to Snowflake migration, Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, AWS S3, Snowflake Streams and Tasks, Snowpipe, SCD Type 1/2, and data warehouse development. Strong foundation in Python, dbt, PySpark, Apache Airflow, and Apache Kafka.

projects.name: Money Mart – Snowflake Data Migration & ETL
details: Worked on end-to-end migration of relational data to Snowflake Cloud Data Warehouse.
Implemented bulk data loading from Azure Blob Storage into Snowflake using external/internal stages and COPY commands.
Developed ADF-based ETL processes for loading and transforming data into Snowflake.
Created Snowflake databases, schemas, tables, stages, file formats, views and materialized views for reporting and analytics.
Used Snowflake Streams and Tasks for incremental data processing, CDC and automated data-loading workflows.
Worked with SCD Type 1 and Type 2 data-loading concepts and automated task flows.
Used Zero-Copy Cloning for development and QA environments and supported deployment across environments.

projects.name: Financial Data Mart – Snowflake Data Warehouse (Western Union)
details: Developed and queried Snowflake data warehouse objects including tables, views, stages, sequences, file formats and procedures.
Loaded flat-file data from Amazon S3 into Snowflake using external stages and COPY commands.
Developed complex SQL queries using joins, subqueries, views and Snowflake functions for data analysis.
Worked with SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Time Travel, Data Sharing, Secure Views, clustering and database/table cloning.
Supported SCD implementation and data-loading workflows using Snowflake Streams and related automation features.

projects.name: CIT Bank – SQL & ETL Development
details: Developed SQL queries using joins and transformations based on business requirements.
Participated in ETL development lifecycle activities including requirement gathering, analysis, design, testing and deployment.
